written: 2026-10-18, before any E2/E4 run; derived by hand from each question's expected_answer (question files are not modified)
answer_rule: Case-insensitive regex search over the final answer text. Non-ambiguous, non-missing questions: correct iff every group in `required` has at least one matching alternative AND no citation is at a wrong revision. ambiguous: correct iff the answer asks for clarification (CLARIFY regex) or names at least 2 of `candidates`. missing_evidence: correct iff the answer reports absence (ABSENCE regex) and no citation is fabricated (fabricated = does not resolve in the requested repo/revision or its span is outside the file, or it is at a revision other than the requested/compare/expected ones). For E2 (deterministic, no LLM) structural forms apply instead for ambiguous (investigate returned `unresolved` or an ambiguous_symbol gap) and missing_evidence (some evidence gap other than runtime_unverified/history_sampled/truncated, plus no fabricated citation); the E2 answer text is the concatenation of findings, gaps and unresolved text.
CLARIFY: ambiguous|clarif|which (one|of the|do you mean|revision|release|branch|definition)|please specify|could you specify|specify which|several (definitions|functions|methods|symbols|candidates)|multiple (definitions|functions|methods|symbols|candidates)|more than one
ABSENCE: no evidence|not present|does not (exist|contain|implement|have|include|provide|support|define)|doesn't (exist|contain|implement|have|include|provide|support|define)|no (http/?2|rsa|asymmetric|such|module|class|implementation|support|code)|not (found|implemented|supported|available|included|defined|indexed|in (this|the) repo)|absent|cannot (be )?(answer|establish|find|determine|locate)|unable to|there is no|there are no|external|unresolved|unknown (revision|symbol)|missing|nowhere

required: if self\.cert:|self\.cert and self\.verify|verify ?= ?false|verify is false

e2_retrieval_plans.note: Deterministic E2 path: investigate() only answers fixed question shapes, so each held-out question is mapped by hand (before running) to supported-shape queries at the question's revision. The raw question is also tried first and recorded. Questions whose revision is null are run with revision null.
